title: On this day, India got its 27th state - and it took seven more years to get its own name back.

sources.text: India TV News - Uttarakhand Foundation Day: What was name of state when it was founded, why was it being changed
Free Press Journal - Uttarakhand Foundation Day: Know History, Significance of Day That Marks Foundation of 27th Indian State

caption:
On this day, India got its 27th state - and it took seven more years to get its own name back.

Formed under the Uttar Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2000, the new state capped decades of a grassroots hill-state movement rooted in the distinct geography and economy of the Garhwal and Kumaon regions, versus the UP plains.

The rename followed sustained public demand to restore the region's historic name. Dehradun became the state capital and November 9 is now marked every year as Uttarakhand Diwas.

Uttarakhand's creation was a bet that a hill region with its own needs would develop faster as its own state than as a distant corner of a much larger one - a bet the state's growth since has largely paid off.
